about: Demonstration formulas from dsm-firmenich's free 'Sharing Innovation' brochures (2016, 2019, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025), read on 2026-10-16 and 2026-10-18.
Each brochure shows its featured ingredients in formulas by Firmenich perfumers. Only ingredient lists and amounts are copied; each formula links to its page in the PDF.
Formulas were read from the PDF text where every line adds up to the printed total of 1000; the rest were transcribed from the page images and checked the same way.

Where a brochure prints several versions of a formula side by side, the version with the featured ingredient is included and the others are described in its note. Formulas a later brochure repeats (same formula number) are included once.
Amounts printed as 0 are traces that round to zero in the brochure.

formulas.title: Hivernal Neo EdT 209331
formulas.style: a fresh floral eau de toilette (at 15%)

formulas.title: Beyond Hivernal EdT 209403
formulas.note: The brochure prints three versions side by side; this is version D. Version E has 20 Beyond Lilyflore® in place of Beyond Hivernal®, and version B has neither (70 Dipropylene Glycol).

formulas.note: The brochure prints three versions side by side; this is version D. Version E has 50 Beyond Lilyflore® in place of Beyond Hivernal®, and version B has neither (170 Dipropylene Glycol).
